content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the BECIL Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 16-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of BECIL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Broadcast Engineering Consultants India Limited (BECIL) for deployment in AIIMS NCI Jhajjar on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under BECIL Advt No 561?
faq.answer: A total of 23 vacancies have been announced across various healthcare and support roles, including Radiotherapy Technician, O.T. Technician, and Data Entry Operator.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for BECIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for successful submission of the online application form is 16-10-2026. Candidates must complete their registration before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is Matriculation (10th pass) for posts like MTS and Khalasi, while other technical and managerial posts require 12th, diplomas, or degrees.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Data Entry Operator (DEO) posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Data Entry Operator position must be between 18 and 40 years of age as per the official recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for SC/ST and PWD candidates?
faq.answer: No, candidates belonging to SC, ST, and PWD categories are exempted from paying any application fee and have a fee of NIL.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range offered for these contract positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 21,502/- to Rs. 40,710/- per month depending upon the specific post and the qualification requirements.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection criteria for BECIL Various Posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial scrutiny and shortlisting based on eligibility criteria, followed by an interview, assessment, skill test, or other evaluation methods.

faq.question: Q9. How can eligible candidates apply for the vacancies?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official registration portal at becilregistration.in, filling out personal details, paying the fee, and submitting the form.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF and application link?
faq.answer: You can find the direct links for the official notification PDF, online application portal, and official website in the Important Links section of this article.
